summary: T10 role implements ruflo CLI + 8-topic cohabitation matrix per §2.4 spec. Core architecture sound: FQCN compliant, idempotent templates, canonical matrix validation. Critical bug in validate_matrix.py return type unpacking (line 139). Variable scoping correct (ruflo_* prefix). Handlers properly notify on template changes. Molecule smoke tests cover file existence + validator exit codes.

correctness_vs_spec_2_4.notes: All 8 topics (core, mcp, wasm, demo-client, docs, loop, protocol-qa, ops) with 7 fields each match §2.4 exactly. Matrix hardcoded in both defaults/main.yml and validate_matrix.py CANONICAL_MATRIX.

idempotency.notes: Templates re-render via ansible.builtin.template (idempotent by default). Validator runs on every apply (changed_when: false) as intended. Handler notify pattern correct.

fqcn_compliance.notes: All modules use FQCN: ansible.builtin.file, ansible.builtin.get_url, ansible.builtin.shell, ansible.builtin.command, ansible.builtin.template, ansible.builtin.copy, ansible.builtin.debug. No deprecated short names.

variable_scoping.notes: Consistent ruflo_* prefix: ruflo_version, ruflo_topic_matrix, ruflo_global_defaults, ruflo_installer_download, ruflo_install_result, ruflo_version_check, ruflo_matrix_validation. No namespace collisions.

handler_design.notes: Handler 'validate ruflo matrix' properly listens to notify calls. Executes validator on template changes. Handler runs validator again (redundant with task but safe pattern).

template_quality.notes: global.yml.j2: clean, 3 fields from defaults. topic.yml.j2: all 7 fields per spec, clear comments. No YAML syntax errors. Comment warns 'DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY'.

molecule_smoke_tests.notes: converge.yml: Python setup, mnemonic user creation, role include with ansible_user var. verify.yml: stat checks for global + 8 topics + validator script. Runs validator and checks exit code. Coverage adequate for smoke.

readme_documentation.notes: Comprehensive: purpose, variables table, matrix structure, behavior (idempotency, installation, validation), files created, specs, acceptance criteria, verification steps. Anchors to §2.4 and user-spec AC25-AC28.

meta_dependencies.notes: meta/main.yml declares dependencies: [] (none required). Correct galaxy tags (ruflo, substrate, fabric). Min Ansible 2.10. No implicit deps on other roles.

tags.notes: No tags defined in tasks/main.yml. Recommend: 'ruflo', 'install', 'config', 'validate' for selective task execution.

findings.task: Add tags to tasks/main.yml for selective execution

cross_role_coupling_mnemonic_tg_bridge_t.notes: mnemonic-mcp role references ~/.fabric/ruflo/hooks.d/molyanov-mnemonic-hooks.yml. This assumes ruflo role has created ~/.fabric/ruflo/ directory structure. Direct file path coupling (not variable). No explicit dependency declared in meta. Potential for race condition if mnemonic-mcp runs before ruflo.

findings.detail: mnemonic-mcp role should declare explicit 'depends_on: [ruflo]' in meta/main.yml or accept hooks.d path as overridable variable
findings.impact: T09 mnemonic-tg-bridge may fail if ruflo not applied first

critical_issues.description: Function validate_matrix() returns (int, str) on error at line 99 but only returns int on success (lines 132, 135). Line 139 unpacks: 'exit_code, message = validate_matrix()' expects tuple always. Success case returns single int, causing ValueError on unpacking.
critical_issues.impact: Validator crashes on successful validation instead of exiting cleanly. Task 10 AC ('validate_matrix.py exits 0') fails.
critical_issues.fix: Return (0, 'Validation OK: ...') on success instead of single int at line 134-135

recommendations.action: Add explicit dependency in mnemonic-mcp meta/main.yml: depends_on [ruflo] or document ordering requirement
Add tags to tasks/main.yml (install, config, validate) for selective role execution
Consider making hooks.d path a configurable variable (ruflo_hooks_dir) to reduce coupling
